fields.System.Title: RET-404 — Return to supplier
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want faulty goods sent back to the supplier, so that we
recover the cost instead of absorbing it.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a supplier-fault grade, then the stock moves to a return-to-supplier location.
  • - Given a return-to-supplier shipment, then it produces a dispatch record and moves stock
  • to VIRT-SUPPLIER.
  • - Given the shipment, then it links to the original receipt and any discrepancy record
  • so the claim is evidenced.
  • - Given the dispatch, then the ERP is notified so a supplier credit can be pursued.
  • - Given stock awaiting return to supplier, then it is aged and escalated.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, inventory, inbound |
| Tables | disposition, stock_balance, stock_movement |
| Risks | Supplier-fault stock written off as warehouse loss |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant |
